items.t: Salesforce Cuts Costs as Stock Slides. Is the Turnaround Case Real?

items.t: Cloud for Good Appoints Former Salesforce Executive Steve Dobbs to Board of Directors
items.sum: Cloud for Good, an industry-focused Salesforce consulting partner, today announced the appointment of Steve Dobbs, former Executive Vice President of Financial Services at Salesforce, to its Board of Directors. Dobbs brings more than 25 years of enterprise software leadership and deep financial services expertise to support the company's continued expansion.
